root_cause: The existing SalesRobot sender reset a waiting action to suggested after any exception from provider transport or subsequent acknowledgement write; the provider may already have sent the message, so a later reattempt could duplicate it.
change: Keep the existing original action claimed/waiting on any ambiguous provider result. Record needs_readback and republish_forbidden without marking a delivery successful. Require existing independent provider evidence before reconciling the original action.
prevention: Never promote an uncertain external side effect to a retryable send.
No replacement channel for an ambiguous addressed send.
Provider authorization, inbox evidence, pipeline tests and production readback required.
requires: SalesRobot license/reactivation and authentic independent provider receipt
truth_boundary: No provider message sent as part of this code change; no paid subscription, connection repair or end-to-end green asserted.
